description_en: Configures monitoring alerts to monitor the latency and exception status of a data migration task
description_zh: 配置监控报警，来监控迁移任务的延迟和异常状态
kebab_example: aliyun dts configure-migration-job-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtslb9113qq11n0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigureMigrationJobAlert

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the data migration instance resides. For more information, see the supported region list
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例所在地域的 ID，详情请参见支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the data migration instance. You can call the DescribeMigrationJobs operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeMigrationJobs接口查询
parameters.name: migration_job_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to monitor the latency status. Valid values:

enable: yes.
disable: no.

Default value: enable.
You must specify at least one of this parameter and the ErrorAlertStatus parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否监控延迟状态，取值：

enable：是。
disable：否。

默认取值为enable。
本参数和ErrorAlertStatus参数两者中至少传入一个
parameters.name: delay_alert_status

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone numbers of contacts for latency alerts. Separate multiple mobile phone numbers with commas (,).

This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com) and supports only Chinese mainland mobile phone numbers. You can specify up to 10 mobile phone numbers.
The China site does not support phone alerts. You can configure alert rules for DTS tasks only in the CloudMonitor console
parameters.help_zh:
延迟报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。

本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入 10 个手机号码。
国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持通过云监控平台为 DTS 任务设置报警规则
parameters.name: delay_alert_phone

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to monitor the exception status. Valid values:

enable: yes.
disable: no.

Default value: enable.
You must specify at least one of this parameter and the DelayAlertStatus parameter.
After you enable the exception status monitoring feature, an alert is triggered when an exception is detected
parameters.help_zh:
是否监控异常状态，取值：

enable：是。
disable：否。

默认取值为enable。
本参数和DelayAlertStatus参数两者中至少传入一个。
开启监控异常状态功能后，如果检测到异常，将触发报警
parameters.name: error_alert_status

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone numbers of contacts for exception alerts. Separate multiple mobile phone numbers with commas (,).

This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com) and supports only Chinese mainland mobile phone numbers. You can specify up to 10 mobile phone numbers.
The international site does not support phone alerts. You can configure alert rules for DTS tasks only in the CloudMonitor console
parameters.help_zh:
异常报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。

本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入 10 个手机号码。
国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持通过云监控平台为 DTS 任务设置报警规则
parameters.name: error_alert_phone

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for triggering a latency alert. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer. Set the threshold based on your business requirements. To avoid latency fluctuations caused by network conditions or database loads, set the threshold to 10 seconds or more.
This parameter is required when DelayAlertStatus is set to enable
parameters.help_zh:
触发延迟报警的阈值，单位为秒且需为整数，可根据业务需要设置阈值，建议设置10秒以上，避免因网络、数据库负载等原因导致的延迟波动。
当DelayAlertStatus取值为enable时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: delay_over_seconds

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号id，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
